lookback_source.quote: Check all treatments, procedures, and programs that the resident received or performed after admission/entry or reentry to the facility and within the last 14 days.

lookback_notes: O0110 is a three-column item. On the O0110 item matrix, K1 Hospice care is displayed with a check box only in column b, While a Resident (p. O-2), whose assessment period is the last 14 days (p. O-1, p. O-3); the rationale text also refers to a "14-day look-back period" (p. O-2). The other O0110 columns carry different windows that are stated on p. O-1/O-3 but are not offered for K1: column a, On Admission = days 1 through 3 of the SNF PPS Stay starting with A2400B; column c, At Discharge = the last 3 days of the SNF PPS Stay ending with A2400C. These coexisting windows are recorded in conflicts.

coding_levels.label: Hospice care — While a Resident
coding_levels.definition: Check when the resident is identified as being in a hospice program, as defined at p. O-7, during the column b assessment period (after admission/entry or reentry and within the last 14 days).

source.quote: Check all treatments, procedures, and programs that the resident received or performed after admission/entry or reentry to the facility and within the last 14 days.

coding_levels.label: None of the above
coding_levels.definition: If no treatments, procedures or programs were received by, performed on, or participated in by the resident within the last 14 days or since admission/entry or reentry, check Z, None of the above.

source.quote: If no treatments, procedures or programs were received by, performed on, or participated in by the resident within the last 14 days or since admission/entry or reentry, check Z, None of the above.

federal_coding_rules.rule: Code residents identified as being in a hospice program for terminally ill persons where an array of services is provided for the palliation and management of terminal illness and related conditions.

source.quote: Code residents identified as being in a hospice program for terminally ill persons where an array of services is provided for the palliation and management of terminal illness and related conditions.

federal_coding_rules.rule: The hospice must be licensed by the state as a hospice provider and/or certified under the Medicare program as a hospice provider.

source.quote: The hospice must be licensed by the state as a hospice provider and/or certified under the Medicare program as a hospice provider.

federal_coding_rules.rule: Column b (While a Resident): check all treatments, procedures, and programs the resident received or performed after admission/entry or reentry to the facility and within the last 14 days.

source.quote: Check all treatments, procedures, and programs that the resident received or performed after admission/entry or reentry to the facility and within the last 14 days.

federal_coding_rules.rule: If nothing in O0110 was received, performed or participated in within the last 14 days or since admission/entry or reentry, check Z, None of the above.

source.quote: If no treatments, procedures or programs were received by, performed on, or participated in by the resident within the last 14 days or since admission/entry or reentry, check Z, None of the above.

federal_coding_rules.rule: O0110Z1, None of the above: code if none of the listed treatments, procedures, or programs were received or performed by the resident.

source.quote: Code if none of the above treatments, procedures, or programs were received or performed by the resident.

federal_coding_rules.rule: General O0110 rule: facilities may code treatments, programs and procedures that the resident performed themselves independently or after set-up by facility staff.

source.quote: Facilities may code treatments, programs and procedures that the resident performed themselves independently or after set-up by facility staff.

federal_coding_rules.rule: General O0110 rule: do not code services that were provided solely in conjunction with a surgical procedure or diagnostic procedure, such as IV medications or ventilators; surgical procedures include routine pre- and post-operative procedures.

source.quote: Do not code services that were provided solely in conjunction with a surgical procedure or diagnostic procedure, such as IV medications or ventilators. Surgical procedures include routine pre- and post-operative procedures.

federal_coding_rules.rule: On the O0110 item matrix, K1 Hospice care is offered with a check box only under column b, While a Resident (no check box under column a, On Admission, or column c, At Discharge).

federal.criterion: Review the resident's medical record to determine whether or not the resident received or performed the treatment, procedure, or program within the assessment period defined for each column.

source.quote: Review the resident’s medical record to determine whether or not the resident received or performed any of the treatments, procedures, or programs within the assessment period defined for each column.

federal.notes: Only assessment step stated for O0110; the manual does not list specific documents for hospice on these pages.

federal.criterion: Evidence that the hospice is licensed by the state as a hospice provider and/or certified under the Medicare program as a hospice provider.

source.quote: The hospice must be licensed by the state as a hospice provider and/or certified under the Medicare program as a hospice provider.

federal.notes: Stated as a coding requirement; the manual does not specify which record element must evidence licensure/certification.

case_mix_relevance.notes: The supplied O0110 pages (O-1 through O-10) do not tie O0110K1, Hospice care, to any payment or case-mix classification. Columns a and c reference SNF PPS Stay dates (A2400B/A2400C), but no payment/case-mix linkage is stated for this sub-item.

conflicts.topic: Coexisting assessment windows within item O0110

positions.claim: Column a, On Admission: assessment period is days 1 through 3 of the SNF PPS Stay starting with A2400B.

source.quote: Check all treatments, procedures, and programs received by, performed on, or participated in by the resident on days 1–3 of the SNF PPS Stay starting with A2400B.

positions.claim: Column b, While a Resident: performed after admission/entry or reentry and within the last 14 days.

source.quote: Check all treatments, procedures, and programs that the resident received or performed after admission/entry or reentry to the facility and within the last 14 days.

positions.claim: Column c, At Discharge: assessment period is the last 3 days of the SNF PPS Stay ending with A2400C.

source.quote: Check all treatments, procedures, and programs received by, performed on, or participated in by the resident in the last 3 days of the SNF PPS Stay ending with A2400C.

conflicts.resolution: Document itself resolves for this sub-item: the O0110 item matrix (p. O-2) offers K1 Hospice care only in column b, so the 14-day window governs; the 3-day admission and 3-day discharge windows apply to other O0110 sub-items. Both/all windows are preserved above.
